# Claude Code Gotchas

> Known Claude Code configuration patterns (hooks, skills, settings.json) that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Hook matcher only matches tool names, not permission-rule syntax](hook-matcher-tool-names-only.md): Permission-rule syntax in a hook matcher field silently never fires; use matcher for the tool name and the if field for argument filtering, and self-filter in the script because if fires conservatively on opaque substitutions. HIGH.
- [Skill frontmatter key disable-model-invocation uses hyphens, not underscores](disable-model-invocation-key-hyphens.md): disable_model_invocation with underscores is silently ignored and the skill stays auto-invocable; all skill frontmatter keys are hyphenated. HIGH.
- [Line-count budgets on CLAUDE.md are silently gamed by long lines](line-budgets-gamed-by-long-lines.md): a "keep under N lines" rule keeps passing while single appended lines grow to thousands of characters and the file's real token cost compounds; budget by bytes (wc -c) and direct feature detail downward into docs with pointer entries. HIGH.
- [Agent prompt style rules do not govern verbatim code moves](agents-copy-style-violations.md): subagents told "never write X" still emit X when relocating existing text verbatim, the violations travel with the copy; enforce by linting the diff's added lines after agent refactors, not by prompt instruction. MEDIUM.
- [A sandboxed Bash failure imitates a missing system dependency](sandboxed-bash-fakes-missing-dependency.md): A sandboxed command can fail to reach files that are genuinely present, and build tooling reports it as a missing system library with an install hint; the false "cannot build here" conclusion then propagates into plans and hedges every downstream claim. Verify the artifact directly (ls the header, run the probe standalone) before concluding the environment lacks it. HIGH.
